description:
Reformat a clinical sepsis protocol draft to meet hospital documentation standards. Open /home/ga/Documents/sepsis_protocol_draft.docx, which contains raw text in the wrong format. You must create a professionally formatted version saved as /home/ga/Documents/sepsis_protocol_formatted.docx. 

Required formatting rules:
1. Font: Liberation Sans (or Arial) at 11pt for all body text.
2. Margins: 1.0 inch on all four sides.
3. Line Spacing: 1.15 spacing for body text.
4. Paragraph Spacing: Add approx. 6pt after each paragraph.
5. Structure: Apply 'Heading 1' style to major sections (Purpose, Definitions, Screening..., Initial Resuscitation, Antimicrobial Therapy, Hemodynamic Management, Organ Support, Monitoring..., References). Apply 'Heading 2' style to subsections (e.g., Fluid Resuscitation, Vasopressor Therapy).
6. Title: Center-align the document title 'Sepsis Management Clinical Protocol'.
7. Header: Add a header to every page reading 'Memorial Regional Hospital — Clinical Protocol — Effective 2024'.

Do not overwrite the original draft.
